svg.title: Centipede — clean editable vector artwork
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the supplied Centipede artwork. Manually drawn character contours, claws, eye, tongue, antennae, energy burst and custom path lettering. Original stippling is simplified into editable smooth ink islands. The lower illustration fades through a removable vector mask. Transparent outside the artwork; no raster images or fonts.

g.inkscape:label: 07 · Open mouth, fangs and curled tongue
